Slid down the bed. Just lift?

No. Use a slide sheet or a hoist. Assess the task, the person, the load and the environment before you move anyone. A full manual lift of a patient's weight is not routine practice.

Would you have A) lifted with a colleague or B) used a slide sheet? Reply A or B.

Free practice questions, no sign-up. Link in bio.

Get one list a week, about 5 to 6 hours: topics, practice tests, a case study, flashcards and a review of your mistakes. Do it in any order, on any day. It adapts after each weekly check.

Bed rails up. Restraint or not?

It can be: intent and effect decide. Restraint can be physical, chemical, mechanical or environmental. Try less restrictive options first, and document them. It is a last resort, time-limited and always reviewed, never an open-ended order.

Would you have said A) restraint or B) not a restraint? Reply A or B.
